channel.title: Push Security incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Push Security's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Microsoft Edge tab communication issue [resolved]
item.description: Version 2\.36\.60 of the Push extension became available at 1:18am UTC on the Chrome store, which contains the fix for this issue. A full writeup of the root cause will follow.

item.title: Brief service disruption [resolved]
item.description:
The Push service experienced a **15-minute disruption**.
**Security controls continued to work normally during this time.** However, any new detection events and browser activity events that occurred during this 15-minute time period were lost and cannot be backfilled.
We'll post a root cause analysis once all details are available.

item.title: ChatOps security team messages not sent for new SaaS, new third-party integrations [resolved]
item.description:
Push identified and fixed a bug that prevented the sending of messages for the SaaS discovery ChatOps topic used for security team notifications. This topic sends messages when Push observes newly discovered SaaS apps and third-party integrations.
The bug was introduced July 4, 2023, and fixed on August 1.
While Push continued to observe and record new apps and new integrations in the Push admin console normally, no ChatOps messages for this topic were triggered during the affected time period. No other ChatOps topics were affected.
Push has improved its monitoring for ChatOps to prevent future similar issues.

item.title: Slack outage [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. All Slack messages that were not delivered during the outage have been queued for resend.

item.title: Webhook processing delays: Detection events [resolved]
item.description: Webhooks are now being delivered normally. Detection events that were delayed during the impacted time period have also all been delivered.

item.title: Cloudflare Turnstile outage [resolved]
item.description: Cloudflare has implemented a fix for the global outage, and Turnstile is now back online. All affected functionality has returned to normal.
